title: 摩根大通：沃什注定让特朗普失望
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: How do you think he will perform for the president, because he was president Trump's pick.
segments.zh: 你觉得他会如何为总统效力？毕竟他是特朗普总统钦点的。

segments.en: He comes out of central casting as the president likes to say, and to some extent, part of his role, at least according to the White House, is to say stuff that suits the president.
segments.zh: 他就像总统常说的那样，是标准人选。某种程度上，白宫希望他发表符合总统立场的言论。

segments.en: It can't work out any other way. If you look at the economy, right now, it's doing great.
segments.zh: 不可能有其他结果。看看当前经济，表现很好。

segments.en: And we're going to see that in the summary of economic projections.
segments.zh: 我们将在经济预测摘要中看到这一点。

segments.en: We're probably going to lower unemployment and raise inflation.
segments.zh: 我们可能会下调失业率预期，上调通胀预期。

segments.en: It will all be fine. But we have to accept the economies in pretty good shape.
segments.zh: 一切都会很好。但我们必须承认经济状况相当不错。

segments.en: That's not an economy where you cut rates. So you're not cutting rates.
segments.zh: 这种经济状况不适合降息。所以你不会降息。

segments.en: I'm interested to see, for the end of 2026, how many dots are there for rate hikes?
segments.zh: 我很想看看，到2026年底，有多少个点显示加息？

segments.en: Do you get two or three? So the president's not going to like that.
segments.zh: 会有两次还是三次？总统可不会喜欢这样。

segments.en: The sequence of events that would cause him to cut rates over the next six to nine months, nobody should want that.
segments.zh: 未来六到九个月导致他降息的事件序列，没人应该期待。

segments.en: It will likely mean that there's problems somewhere in the economy.
segments.zh: 这很可能意味着经济某处出了问题。

segments.en: That unemployment is going up. That's something stagnating.
segments.zh: 失业率上升，某些方面停滞不前。

segments.en: That's not a healthy economy. And if he has to cut rates in that kind of environment, the president won't be happy with the macroeconomic
segments.zh: 这不是健康的经济。如果他在那种环境下降息，总统不会对宏观环境满意。
